scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide-angle view of a city street with buildings on both sides, featuring a mix of old and new architecture, including a large cathedral-like structure on the right and a row of older buildings on the left. The street is lined with trees and bushes, and there are several pedestrians walking along the sidewalk. The sky is overcast, casting long shadows across the scene. The ground is covered in dirt and leaves, with some patches of grass and flowers visible. A white rope barrier runs along the edge of the sidewalk, separating the pedestrian path from the street. The buildings on the left side of the street appear to be residential, while those on the right side are commercial or possibly industrial. The cathedral-like structure dominates the right side of the street, its intricate stonework and pointed arches visible even from afar. The street itself is relatively narrow, with a few cars parked along the curb. Overall, the scene exudes a sense of history and culture, with a mix of old and new elements blending together seamlessly.
scene_analysis.buildings: Left building: cream rendered facade with stone quoins at the corners. Right: exposed red brick upper floors above a polished granite shopfront. Foreground: hexagonal ceramic pavement tiles.
scene_analysis.building_condition: Left building: old, worn, with peeling paint and broken windows. Right building: modern, sleek, with clean lines and minimal ornamentation.
